name: scoremate
description: ScoreMate — Street cricket, scored cleanly. Track every run, wicket, and over with ease.

scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:open: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:build: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.ios:open: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap build ios
